DOPPLER EFFECT — THE BREATH OF THE ORGANISM (Wave 239j)

The particle model gains a 5th dimension: VELOCITY.

- proton (p⁺) = red/far — charged, identity

- BLUE SHIFT = particle APPROACHING nucleus → gaining mass → materializing
